# graphviz-pure-skrifa

Patched fork of upstream [skrifa 0.44.0](https://crates.io/crates/skrifa/0.44.0), from [googlefonts/fontations](https://github.com/googlefonts/fontations), for graphviz-pure. This is not an upstream release.

Transcendental floating-point calls use `libm` so raster output is portable across platforms. The Rust library target remains `skrifa`.

Upstream copyright notices and the Apache-2.0 and MIT licence texts in `LICENSE-APACHE` and `LICENSE-MIT` are retained.
